jamal: quick ping — PR #4218 is blocked by two tiny lint failures (naming + gofumpt). can someone with merge perms give a quick look?
ashley: on it, can you paste the CI link and the failing lines?
jamal: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/4218 — gofumpt diff inside `proto/connection.proto` and one naming nit in `pkg/net/conn.go`.
jamal: ```diff
- func NewConn(connID string) *Conn {
+ func NewConn(connId string) *Conn {
     return &Conn{ID: connID}
 }
```
kevin: I can take the naming change. quick question: do we prefer `connID` or `connId` for unexported args? our linter has been flip-flopping.
maria: quick style reminder — exported struct fields should keep initialisms as `ID` (e.g., `UserID`), but local params can be `id`/`connId`. so in constructors we usually use `id`.
kevin: ok i'll change the param to `id` and leave field as `ID`, push a tiny commit.
ci-bot: CI update — build queued for PR #4218 (gofumpt + unit tests).
kevin: pushed `fix(pr-4218): param name + run gofumpt` — commit abcdef1
ci-bot: CI update — build passed ✅
jamal: awesome, thanks all :tada: merging now.
ashley: thanks kevin, thanks maria :thumbsup:
